name: Henrietta
source:
Henrietta belongs to one of the four noble vampire families in the makai, specifically, to the one who controls the element of wind. She's Aaron's childhood friend and her self-proclaimed fiancée. Because of that, she sees Yuri as her love rival.
She's Algernon's twin sister.
